description: This file defines a React component tree selector engine for use with Playwright, including functions to parse React component trees and find React root elements within a DOM scope.

methods.name: getFunctionComponentName
methods.description: Returns the display name or 'Anonymous' for a React component function.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Determines the component name from a ReactVNode, supporting React 15 and 16+.

methods.name: getComponentKey
methods.description: Retrieves the key of a ReactVNode.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the children of a ReactVNode, supporting React 15 and 16+.

methods.name: getProps
methods.description: Extracts props from a ReactVNode, removing 'children'.

methods.name: buildComponentsTree
methods.description: Builds a component tree from a ReactVNode.

methods.name: filterComponentsTree
methods.description: Filters a component tree based on a search function.

methods.name: findReactRoots
methods.description: Finds React root nodes within a DOM or Shadow DOM.
